description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—across a metric labeled “Accuracy (%)”. The horizontal axis displays the model names in alphabetical order, with labels “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct”, “Audio-Reasoner”, and “Qwen-2.5-Omni”. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  The chart contains three blue bars, each representing a model’s accuracy. The “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct” bar has a height of approximately 48, the “Audio-Reasoner” bar reaches approximately 32, and the “Qwen-2.5-Omni” bar extends to approximately 64. All bars are the same color and width, with no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar. A legend indicates that the bars represent “MMAU” and “MMAR” data, but the chart only displays bars for one category, “MMAU”.
